certificate.source_clause: Execute a deterministic TMM optimization for a planar three-medium stack: Incident Air (n=1.0), Layer 1 (SiO2, n=1.46, lossless), Layer 2 (TiO2, n=2.40, lossless), Substrate Glass (n=1.52, lossless). Optimize the thickness of Layer 1 and Layer 2 to minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at normal incidence over the wavelength range 450 nm to 700 nm (5 nm spacing). Con
